Luba 
 CNC operator 
 - € 2972 - Eindhoven - 40 uur - Uitzicht op vast - Mbo 
Start your career as a cnc operator in Eindhoven and work full-time with the latest technology. Enjoy a modern team, tasty lunches, and plenty of growth opportunities. 
 Over het werk 
Do you want to use and further develop your technical skills? As a cnc operator, you get the chance to work with the most modern machines in the production of high-tech parts. You work full-time, during the day, in an innovative environment where your development is key. You'll have plenty of opportunities for training and to grow within the company. This position is for the long term, so you're really helping to build the future! 
You start your working day by setting up and operating cnc machines, including 5-axis milling, wire EDM, and precision grinding. You read technical drawings, prepare the machines, and check if all parts meet the highest quality standards. You immediately notice if something needs adjusting, think along with the programmers, and do daily minor maintenance. This way, you and your colleagues ensure a safe, tidy workplace and continuously improve the production process. 
Does it sound exciting to work with the latest technologies and be a key player in production? Do you want to learn, grow, and really make an impact in technology? Apply now for this cnc operator position and discover how you can make a difference! 
 Wat wij bieden 
 - Salary starting at € 17.08 per hour - Working hours 07:00 - 15:30 - Free lunch and dinner at work - Lots of room for personal growth and development - Work with the latest cnc technology in a high-tech environment 
 Wat wij vragen 
 - You have mbo-level education or comparable technical experience - You have experience with cnc machining (milling, grinding, or drilling is a plus) - You can read and understand technical drawings - You work accurately and have an eye for quality - You speak and write English well

Production Worker (Early Shift)  As a Production Worker in the egg breaking department, you are responsible for operating and monitoring the machines that process eggs. You start your workday early in the morning at 05:00 by preparing the production line and setting up the machinery. Throughout the shift, you monitor the automated process that breaks eggs and separates egg whites from yolks, while performing quality and hygiene checks. At the end of the shift, you thoroughly clean the equipment and work environment together with your team, ensuring everything is ready for the next day.
 This is a position through Staffice at our client, with the prospect of a permanent contract after 3 months of full-time work!
 Responsibilities  -  Operating and monitoring the egg breaking and separation machines starting at 05:00
 
 -  Checking the quality and separation of egg whites and egg yolks
 
 -  Conducting regular visual quality and hygiene inspections during production
 
 -  Cleaning and sanitizing production equipment and the work environment after production
 
 -  Working efficiently alongside team members to ensure all daily batches are processed
 
 
 Requirements  -  Great motivation, reliability, and a positive work attitude
 
 -  Availability to start work early in the morning at 05:00
 
 -  Willingness to work occasionally on Saturdays according to the team schedule
 
 -  Ability to work until all planned daily processing is completed
 
 -  Good command of the English or Dutch language
 
 
 We offer  -  Working via Staffice at this client with the prospect of a permanent contract after 3 months
 
 -  Gross hourly wage of € 14.99 per hour
 
 -  Weekly payment of your salary and flexible payment options
 
 -  25 holiday days based on a full-time contract
 
 -  8% holiday allowance
 
 -  Travel allowance for your daily commute
 
 -  Personal guidance and support from Staffice throughout your employment
 
 -  Een leuke werksfeer is gegarandeerd.

Do you also love when things are clean and tidy? Great! Our client in Schiphol-Rijk is looking for someone to clean the premises during the day shift. Your salary in this role is €16.06 gross per hour and you will also accrue pension via Manpower. If you are interested, keep on reading, because you can start this new job soon!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for multiple cleaners during the morning shift for Material In Motion in Schiphol-Rijk.

Note: You have to live in The Netherlands to be considered for this job.

Your day starts with an explanation of which areas need to be cleaned. You and your colleagues discuss the tasks and divide the activities. Cleaning the work floor and canteen, cleaning sanitary facilities and cleaning the outdoor terrain are all part of your activities.

What’s in it for you?

    - Gross salary of €16.06 per hour
    
- Reimbursement of travel expenses at €0.23 per kilometre with a maximum of 70 kilometres per day
    
- Full-time job for 40 hours a week
    
- A job for a longer period of time 
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower

    - Availability from Monday through Friday for 40 hours a week
    
- Good command of the English language, both spoken and written
    
- Some working experience as a cleaner is preferred

You preferably live in or near Schiphol-Rijk, Amstelveen, Amsterdam or Hoofddorp.

Do you meet the job requirements and are you interested in this position? Apply today and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

- Performing quality checks on products

- 27 vacation days per year

- Strong attention to detail and quality
- Good Dutch, German or English language skills, both written and spoken

Are you interested?
Apply today or contact Mette or July at +31 (0)77 382 89 46.
